title: Foundations for a relocated cabin: consent refused (Tokoroa)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted

facts.text: Applicants' property is a large flat section in Tokoroa; the cabin was built elsewhere and is being relocated; consent sought for foundations and associated connections.

Authority's reasons included its view that the cabin itself must be assessed for Building Code compliance; the authority also declined to process a CoA because the cabin was built in another district.
Determination is limited to the foundation consent refusal; the manufacturer's construction work is outside the matter.
